label: Retrieved Averroes’s philosophical rationalism to reopen critical inquiry inside Islamic thought
description: Arkoun excavated classical Arabic humanism and Averroist rationalism to show that closed scriptural orthodoxy was a historical political construct, not Islam’s essence.
dialecticalTension: Bridges medieval Falsafa to post-structuralist critique of religious reason.

label: Adapted Foucauldian archaeology and discourse theory to excavate the "unthought" in Islam
description: Deploying Foucault’s episteme and historical critique, Arkoun mapped how orthodox jurists police the boundary between the thinkable and the unthinkable.
dialecticalTension: Applies French archaeological method to Islamic scripture and historical reason.

citations.author: Mohammed Arkoun
citations.work: The Unthought in Contemporary Islamic Thought

label: Catalyzed contemporary historical-critical Islamic hermeneutics across the Arab world
description: Arkoun’s distinction between the open Qur’anic event and closed orthodox dogma directly reinforced Abu Zayd’s humanistic hermeneutic project.
dialecticalTension: Shared Maghrebi-Egyptian front for historical-critical Islamic philosophy.
